people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because Yahweh had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.
translations.bsb: David did not count the men aged twenty or under, because the LORD had said that He would make Israel as numerous as the stars of the sky.
translations.kjv: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.
translations.asv: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under, because Jehovah had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of heaven.
